name: C# · Round 2
domainSummary: A modern statically typed language on .NET with a common type system, managed runtime, generics, delegates and events, LINQ, asynchronous Task-based programming, value and reference types, and cross-language runtime integration.
evidenceBoundary: Keep the selected protected-core idea, but the generic faceted vault is not enough. Use four crossing structural strokes, sharp facets, managed-runtime boundaries, delegate fan-out, async suspension bridges, and boxed nested courts as language-specific architecture. Never display a literal C# wordmark or exact logo.

iterationBasis.strategy: preserve selected structural DNA and add visible domain identity

researchSources.title: Common Type System
researchSources.use: Value and reference types, type safety, runtime management, and cross-language integration.

researchSources.title: Delegates
researchSources.use: Type-safe method references and multicast invocation.

researchSources.title: Async
researchSources.use: Task-based asynchronous execution and awaitable coordination.

assets.name: C# · Sharp Grid Foundry
assets.controlledVariable: Organize four heavy crossing structural strokes over a compact managed-runtime court so the roof plan quietly suggests a hash without drawing a symbol. Use sharp bevels and consistent right-angle joints as the main silhouette.
assets.thesis: A restrained C-sharp cultural cue expressed as structure.
assets.businessCue: A restrained C-sharp cultural cue expressed as structure.

assets.name: C# · Common Type Rotunda
assets.controlledVariable: Build twin value-type and reference-type wings around one common type-system rotunda. Give the value side compact embedded cells and the reference side linked address galleries, while both share identical runtime gates.
assets.thesis: The .NET common type system and value/reference distinction.
assets.businessCue: The .NET common type system and value/reference distinction.

assets.name: C# · Managed Runtime Vault
assets.controlledVariable: Retain a protected central chamber but expose the services around it: allocation, type safety, exception handling, metadata, and managed execution galleries. Make the boundary protective without resembling a bunker.
assets.thesis: Managed execution and runtime services in .NET.
assets.businessCue: Managed execution and runtime services in .NET.

assets.name: C# · Async/Await Relay
assets.controlledVariable: Create several Task bridges that depart the main execution hall, pause at suspended waiting platforms, and rejoin through continuation gates when ready. Other routes must remain active while one bridge waits.
assets.thesis: Task-based asynchronous control flow and continuations.
assets.businessCue: Task-based asynchronous control flow and continuations.

assets.name: C# · Multicast Delegate Hall
assets.controlledVariable: Place one type-safe invocation chamber at the center and fan it through a verified signature gate to several receiver bays arranged in order. Show add and remove side gates and one compact invocation list gallery.

assets.name: C# · LINQ Pipeline
assets.controlledVariable: Build a clean composable query promenade through filter, map, group, and projection halls, all operating over one typed collection court. Keep the path modular and readable without arrows or textual operators.
assets.thesis: Composable language-integrated queries over typed data.
assets.businessCue: Composable language-integrated queries over typed data.

assets.name: C# · Generic Constraint Forge
assets.controlledVariable: Create interchangeable type modules that enter a common processing frame only when they fit explicit structural constraint gates. Make covariance and contravariance visible through paired directional balcony connections.
assets.thesis: Generics, constraints, and reusable type-safe composition.
assets.businessCue: Generics, constraints, and reusable type-safe composition.

assets.name: C# · Event Mesh Pavilion
assets.controlledVariable: Arrange publisher towers and subscriber halls around a protected event court. Connections may be added or removed at explicit registration gates, but publishers never enter subscriber interiors directly.

assets.name: C# · Boxing and Unboxing Court
assets.controlledVariable: Place a compact value chamber inside a larger reference shell connected by controlled boxing and unboxing thresholds. Echo the nested geometry across the roof while keeping the outer protected-core silhouette.
assets.thesis: The value/reference boundary and boxing behavior.
assets.businessCue: The value/reference boundary and boxing behavior.

assets.name: C# · C# Runtime Synthesis
assets.controlledVariable: Combine the protected managed-runtime core, subtle four-stroke sharp grid, common type wings, async continuation bridges, multicast delegate fan-out, LINQ promenade, and nested boxing court. Keep one dominant silhouette and subordinate the easter eggs.
assets.thesis: C# and .NET as a typed, managed, asynchronous application platform.
assets.businessCue: C# and .NET as a typed, managed, asynchronous application platform.
